title: Stator
purpose: In a brushless DC (BLDC) motor, the stator consists of a series of coils or windings that create a rotating magnetic field when electric current flows through them. This magnetic field interacts with the rotor, the moving part of the motor that contains the magnets, causing it to spin.
design: This stator is modeled from a 100KV Sunnysky motor, which has 21 pole pairs and 36 stator teeth. To make the gearbox more compact, I wanted to place the ring gear between the stator teeth, but the cylinder at the center of the stator was in the way. I tried taking the coils off the stator, but it would not budge, so I placed the ring gear slightly above the cylinder instead.
